independent_hypothesis: The frozen selector lacks causal multi-bar price action. Adding a fixed multi-horizon S5-derived structure vector may improve incremental after-cost net versus all-trades.
holdout: Events after anchor_utc are sealed and unread.

truth_contract.price: observed bid/ask S5 only; mid is used for pre-entry features, never as an executable fill
truth_contract.bar: causal completed M5 bars aggregated only from complete S5 records
truth_contract.gap_gate: each M5 bar requires exactly 60 unique S5 timestamps and every adjacent lookback M5 bar must be 300 seconds apart
truth_contract.lookback: 48 completed M5 bars ending strictly before ORDER_ACCEPTED feature_at

fixed_price_action_features: mid returns over 1, 3, 12 and 48 completed M5 bars
range position within prior 12 and 48 bars
distance from prior 12 and 48 bar high and low
median spread bps over prior 12 and 48 bars
range expansion: last 3-bar high-low divided by prior 12-bar high-low

model.single_change: append the fixed price-action vector to the frozen metadata/forecast feature vector
model.estimator: same frozen HistGradientBoostingRegressor parameters as f35e8c176
model.selection: predicted future net JPY > 0; S5-feature-missing episodes pass through as TRADE
model.multidimensional_sweep: deferred; no dimension is swept until this fixed admission test proves incremental signal

split: same chronological 60/40, one-hour embargo and close-time purge as frozen admission; fit rows require causal S5 features; validation missing-feature rows pass through

acceptance.net_jpy: strictly greater than all-trades on the identical full validation cohort
acceptance.stability: positive incremental net and LCB on both 32d and 64d evaluable windows; 16d minimum gate is reported
acceptance.policy_admission: still blocked until all-entry counterfactual and decision-time margin coverage are complete
